nodes.title: Playable room • reference • Eden Live
widgets_values: A single knight explores the same stone dungeon room and collects three luminous crystals. Preserve the camera and fixed obstacles. No text or HUD.

nodes.title: Start here
widgets_values: Queue to create an actual keyboard-controlled proxy room inside ComfyUI. Click the room, use WASD, collect crystals, and record 5 seconds. This is not neural rendering. Set a reference image for Eden; configure a real local Eden GPU service before using Connect Eden Live. Copy the session id from the output for the register/replay workflows.
